title: Technical Conflict Resolution
question: Describe a situation where you had a strong technical disagreement with a peer or teammate. How did you resolve it?

rubric.name: situation_context
rubric.description: Explains the technical context and why the disagreement arose.

rubric.name: communication_empathy
rubric.description: Demonstrates active listening, respect for alternative viewpoints, and objective evaluation.

rubric.name: resolution_action
rubric.description: Describes data-driven or consensus-building steps taken to resolve the dispute.

rubric.name: project_outcome
rubric.description: Details the final technical outcome and impact on team dynamics.

rubric.name: reflection
rubric.description: Reflects on personal communication style and working relationship outcomes.

expected_signals: Uses data, benchmarks, or prototypes to evaluate options objectively
Focuses on shared team goal rather than personal victory
Maintains professional empathy and constructive dialogue
red_flags: Escalates to management without attempting peer dialogue
Dismisses opposing technical opinions out of hand
Remains passive and yields without discussing trade-offs
follow_up_prompts: How did you ensure the working relationship remained healthy after the decision?
If new data contradicted your initial preference, how did you adjust your position?
